topic: Preserving Literal Special Symbols in PDF Generation with Aspose.PDF
main_problem_solved: Adds the Page.ProcessSpecialSymbols property (default true) to control processing of placeholders like $p and $P, allowing them to be rendered as literal text when set to false.
